title: An efficient approach to estimate the risk of coronary artery disease for people living with HIV using machine-learning-based retinal image analysis.
summary: Automated retinal-image analysis was prospectively assessed for coronary-artery-disease risk in people living with HIV and compared with reference clinical assessment; conclusions are cohort-specific.
